AUTHOR: Ovegård
TITLE: Estimating escapees using automated video analysis: Assessing the sorting efficiency of the Excluder in the North Sea sandeel fishery
DATA: Own GoPro video at Excluder exit hole in commercial sandeel trawls; 4 successful hauls (2022) used for escapee estimation
V_EV: Sec. 2.4: recordings 'only classified as successful if the picture covered the exit hole and had sufficient visibility'; Fig. 3: failures due to 'insufficient light'
D2: Train 11,940 / val 1,108 / test 735 boxes; test = 450 images drawn from all analysed hauls by time-series splitting (~0.4 images/min/haul)
D_EV: Sec. 2.5: 'tested on a separate data set (Test) of 450 annotated images subtracted from all hauls (sampling by time series splitting...)'
R_EV: Discussion: 'the image analysis conducted during this study was only possible to apply to four hauls, all from the same area and year'
C_EV: Sec. 2.5: 'confidence threshold ≥ 0.7 (priority to reducing false positives)'; 'To reduce possible double counting... based on tracks with a minimum length of 5 frames'
E_EV: Table 5: escapee counts per class and haul used for sorting efficiency, e.g. gadoid haul 14 'Escapees 26901... Sorting efficiency 100'
ARCH: YOLOv8 (Ultralytics) + ByteTrack, min track length 5 frames
METR: per-class precision, recall, F1 at conf 0.7, IoU 0.5; escapee counts; sorting efficiency
NOTE: V_ALL=N per P1: footage restricted to recordings with 'sufficient visibility' without measurement (depth reported). Test images drawn from same hauls by time-series sampling (not random, but frame-level within same videos) -> coded 이미지/프레임 무작위. Escapee counts are combined with landed-catch counts to compute sorting efficiency; no validation of AI counts against an independent count of escapees -> E5=없음, E2=N. Low recall (0.33-0.57) explicitly linked to underestimation -> E4=FNR. ENV: shallow sandbank trawling, no matching category.
